name: Sika Stabilizer-440 RCR
paste:
SIKA® STABILIZER-440 RCR: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Stabilizer-440 RCR, June 2024, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/6/sika-stabilizer-440rcr.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Stabilizer-440 RCR where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2024, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. Special admixture for treating returned concrete. Sika® Stabilizer-440 RCR is a user-friendly, powdered admixture used to recycle the returned concrete after a proper treatment at the batching plant.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® Stabilizer-440 RCR is suitable for treating the general concrete returning to the batching plant for any reasons and that cannot be reused in the same day production. Adding Sika® Stabilizer-440 RCR to the returned concrete as per the application information below, will turn fresh concrete in a granular, dry material, like an artificial aggregate that might be conveniently used in the construction industry, either in concrete production or engineered backfilling, once completely dry.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Stabilizer-440 RCR
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Admixture for recycling the returned concrete
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (June 2024, Version 01.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS1012.3.1: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Application Information > Dispensing (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - User friendly
    - Acts quickly
    - One-dose-fit all concept
    - Suitable for various types of concrete
    - Packed in soluble bags
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Blend of selected modified co-polymers.
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 16 bags, 930 g each, in a plastic pail. 32 pails per pallet.
    - Shelf life: 12 months if stored as directed
    - Storage conditions: Store Sika® Stabilizer-440 RCR in very dry conditions at temperature between 5°C and 35°C.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (June 2024, Version 01.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2024, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Dispensing.
    - Ascertain the volume of the concrete returned;
    - Ensure that the slump of the returned concrete does not exceed 140 mm (AS1012.3.1);
    - Add one bag of Sika® Stabilizer-440 RCR for each cubic metre of returned concrete directly in the agi-truck barrel;
    - Mix at maximum speed, 1 minute/treated cubic metre or till the concrete granulates;
    - Unload the granulated materials after the treatment in a covered area in layers, no more than 25 cm thick;
    - Rework quickly (lift-remix) the granulated by-product by using the wheel loader in use at the batching plant after 3-4 hours from the initial process. Keep the material in dry conditions for at least 24 hours.
    A solar day after the treatment, the granulated material can be collected and stored for the next use. At this stage a further remix might be needed to ensure even dimensions of the treated material.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (June 2024, Version 01.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Stabilizer-440 RCR, June 2024, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/6/sika-stabilizer-440rcr.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Stabilizer-440 RCR, version 11/06/2024, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/MSDS%20Stabilizer-440%20RCR%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® Stabilizer-440 RCR, version 22/02/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/j/sds-sika-stabilizer-440rcr.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
